quote: We introduce BROWSING LOST UNFORMED RECOLLECTIONS (BLUR), a multimodal and multilingual benchmark for general AI assistants featuring 573 curated tip-of-the-tongue questions, validation chains, and corresponding answers.
BLUR is a benchmark designed to evaluate general AI assistants on a series of tip-of-the-tongue known-item retrieval tasks.
